title: Niksen Is the Dutch Lifestyle Concept of Doing Nothing

sentences: First there was hygge, the Danish concept that made staying in and getting cozy cool.
Then there was lagom, the Swedish mindset of approaching life with an "everything in moderation" mindset.
Now there's another Northern European trend that's being embraced as a way to combat our increasingly busy and often stressful lives: niksen.
The Dutch concept is as simple as, well, doing nothing.
translations: 首先是 hygge，这个丹麦概念让宅在家里和享受舒适变得很酷。
然后是 lagom，这种瑞典心态主张以“凡事适度”的方式对待生活。
现在又出现了一种北欧潮流，它被当作对抗我们日益忙碌且常充满压力的生活的一种方式：niksen。
这个荷兰概念简单来说就是，嗯，什么都不做。

sentences: Niksen "literally means to do nothing, to be idle or doing something without any use," says Carolien Hamming, managing director of CSR Centrum, a coaching center in the Netherlands that helps clients manage stress and recover from burnout.

Practicing niksen could be as simple as just hanging around, looking at your surroundings or listening to music — "as long as it's without purpose," she says, and not done in order to achieve something or be productive.
translations: 尼克斯森“字面意思是什么都不做，无所事事，或者做毫无用处的事情，”荷兰CSR Centrum咨询中心的总经理卡罗琳·哈明说，该中心帮助客户管理压力并从倦怠中恢复。
练习尼克斯森可以简单到只是闲逛、看看周围环境或听音乐——“只要没有目的，”她说，并且不是为了实现某事或提高效率而做。

sentences: Think "simply sitting in a chair or looking out of the window," says Ruut Veenhoven, a sociologist and professor at Erasmus University Rotterdam in the Netherlands who studies happiness.
Whereas mindfulness is about being present in the moment, niksen is more about carving out time to just be, even letting your mind wander rather than focusing on the details of an action.
translations: 荷兰鹿特丹伊拉斯姆斯大学研究幸福的社会学家兼教授鲁特·维恩霍文说，想想“只是坐在椅子上或看着窗外”。
正念强调的是活在当下，而尼可森则更侧重于留出时间只是存在，甚至让思绪漫游，而不是专注于某个行动的细节。

sentences: "We should have moments of relaxation, and relaxation can be combined with easy, semi-automatic activity, such as knitting," Veenhoven says.
"One aspect of the 'art of living' is to find out what ways of relaxing fit you best."
There's not necessarily a one-size-fits-all approach; rather, you'll discover which behaviors are most effective for you though trial and error, he adds.
translations: "我们应该有放松的时刻，而放松可以与轻松、半自动的活动相结合，比如编织，"维恩霍文说。
"生活艺术的一个方面是找出最适合你的放松方式。"
他补充说，不一定有一种放之四海而皆准的方法；相反，你会通过试错发现哪些行为对你最有效。

sentences: What are the potential benefits of niksen?
translations: 尼可森（niksen）的潜在好处是什么？

sentences: In the Netherlands, niksen has historically been dismissed as laziness or as the opposite of being productive, Hamming says.

But as stress levels climb in the U.S. and globally and their crushing health impacts, like burnout, are getting more recognition from the medical community, doing nothing is increasingly being framed as a positive, stress-fighting tactic.
translations: 哈明表示，在荷兰，尼克斯（niksen）历来被视为懒惰或与高效相反的行为。
但随着美国及全球压力水平上升，以及压力带来的严重健康影响（如职业倦怠）日益受到医学界重视，无所事事正逐渐被塑造成一种积极的抗压策略。

sentences: "Everyone is looking for some way back to ease and connection," says Eve Ekman, director of training at the Greater Good Science Center at the University of California, Berkeley, who calls the national levels of stress among adults and teens in the U.S. "daunting."
translations: "每个人都在寻找某种回归轻松与联系的方式，"加州大学伯克利分校至善科学中心培训主任伊芙·埃克曼说道，她将美国成人和青少年的全国压力水平称为"令人望而生畏"。

sentences: But Ekman, who studies stress and burnout, says the research is strong when it comes to the benefits of slowing down, from emotional perks — like reducing anxiety — to physical advantages — like curtailing the aging process and strengthening the body's ability to fight off a common cold.
These potential health effects might be enough to encourage even the most hectic and overburdened among us to consider carving out time to practice niksen.
translations: 但研究压力和倦怠的埃克曼表示，关于放慢节奏的好处的证据很充分，从情绪上的益处（如减少焦虑）到身体上的优势（如延缓衰老过程和增强身体抵抗普通感冒的能力）。
这些潜在的健康影响可能足以鼓励我们当中最忙碌和负担最重的人考虑抽出时间来练习尼克斯（niksen）。

sentences: Another benefit of niksen is that it can help people come up with new ideas, according to Veenhoven, who is also the director of the World Database of Happiness, an archive of research related to life enjoyment.

"Even when we 'niks,'" or do nothing, "our brain is still processing information and can use the available processing power to solve pending problems," he says, which in turn can boost one's creativity.
This could manifest in having a breakthrough solution to a problem on a walk or a great business idea reveal itself while daydreaming.
translations: 根据Veenhoven的说法，niksen的另一个好处是它可以帮助人们产生新想法。Veenhoven也是世界幸福数据库的主任，该数据库是一个与生活享受相关的研究档案。
他说：“即使我们在‘niks’（即什么都不做），我们的大脑仍在处理信息，并可以利用可用的处理能力来解决未解决的问题。”这反过来可以提升一个人的创造力。
这可能会表现为在散步时突然找到问题的突破性解决方案，或者在白日梦中浮现出一个绝妙的商业想法。

sentences: Research also supports the idea that doing simple tasks that allow your mind to wander can foster creative problem solving, even improving your ability to work through a problem you might have been stuck on earlier.

A 2013 study published in Frontiers in Psychology, on the pros and cons of a wandering mind, showed that this process can help an individual get inspired about achieving his or her goals and gain clarity about the actions to take in order to meet those goals in the future.
translations: 研究也支持这样一种观点：做一些让思绪游离的简单任务可以促进创造性问题的解决，甚至能提高你解决之前可能卡住的问题的能力。
2013年发表在《心理学前沿》上的一项关于思绪游离利弊的研究表明，这一过程可以帮助个人在实现目标方面获得灵感，并明确未来为实现这些目标应采取的行动。
